notes.title: Patch notes for version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone here are the new patch notes:

Added new Fruits.

Added a new languages(Russia, Spanish, German) these can be changed on the settings menu.

Added a new Tag System for fruits called Ascended.

Ascended Fruits can be obtained by crafting with 10 Ascended Fruits Bits, you have a small chance of getting these Bits every time you Chop a Fruit.

Thanks for your support and have fun.
